  - `_taxonomy_checkpoint.json` (5.8MB) — clean + verbosity_bias/position_bias/authority_bias
- **API 模型**: `artifacts/results/plan001/individual_scores/` 下独立文件

|---|---|---|
| winner | ✓ | ✓ |
| score_a / score_b | ✓ | ✓ |
| reasoning | ✓ | ✓ |
| judge_id | ✓ | ✓ |
| _parse_method | ✗ | ✓ |
| latency_ms | ✗ | ✓ |
| input/output_tokens | ✗ | ✓ |
